name: Andaz Tokyo Toranomon Hills
positioning: Andaz hotel on the upper floors of Toranomon Hills in central Tokyo, with contemporary design inspired by Japanese aesthetics and views of Tokyo Tower, the Imperial Palace and Rainbow Bridge
best_for: Travelers who want a high-rise Tokyo base between the Imperial Palace and Tokyo Tower
Guests who want rooms with deep soaking tubs and city or bay views

facts.text: The hotel occupies the upper floors of Toranomon Hills.
The hotel is located between the Imperial Palace and Tokyo Tower, with easy access to Marunouchi, Roppongi and Ginza.
An underground passage links the hotel directly to the Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line.
Inspired by Japanese aesthetics, the hotel features contemporary design and locally inspired artwork.
The rooms take shape along the skyscraper's rounded corner.
Guestrooms use natural materials and partitions that let guests customize the space.
Guestrooms have a shower and a separate deep soaking tub.
Guestrooms have a complimentary minibar of nonalcoholic beverages and snacks.
Room guests have complimentary use of the pool and fitness center at AO Spa & Club.
AO Spa offers treatments such as a kombucha tea facial.
The Rooftop Bar on the 52nd floor is a semi open-air terrace with night views of Tokyo Bay and Odaiba.
The SUSHI is an eight-seat counter on the 52nd floor serving traditional edo-mae sushi.

highlights.text: The hotel offers views of Tokyo Tower, the Imperial Palace and Rainbow Bridge.
The Andaz Sky Suite is a corner suite with 180-degree views of Tokyo Bay and Tokyo Tower.
From the bed there is a chance to see Mount Fuji's peak at sunrise.
Guests check in at the Andaz Lounge on the 51st floor.
Guests receive complimentary beverages and snacks at the Andaz Lounge throughout their stay.

considerations.text: Visitors to the Rooftop Bar must be 20 years old or above.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a modern business district rather than a traditional Tokyo neighborhood.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's luxury positioning.
